channel.title: GEO Encyclopedia
channel.description: 50 in-depth articles on Generative Engine Optimization, from fundamentals to implementation. Master the GEO playbook for AI-era brand growth.

item.title: What GEO Work Actually Moves AI Crawlers? Our Data, and a New-Site Launch Checklist
item.description: We attributed two weeks of AI crawler traffic to nine GEO measures on geo010.com. Real numbers show which ones matter, which did nothing, and the exact checklist to build first on a new site — plus the two earlier conclusions we corrected with the logs.

item.title: What Actually Gets Your Site Crawled by AI? Our Two-Week Data, and the Mistake We Retired
item.description: Two weeks of crawl logs from geo010.com, stripped of scanner noise: which GEO changes drove real AI crawler visits, why our AI discovery endpoints got zero requests, and how to tell a genuine spike from an attack wearing a crawler's name.

item.title: How We Made GEO Encyclopedia AI-Discoverable in One Week — a Site-Owner Playbook
item.description: Our week of building AI crawler visibility with the real numbers: 2,335 log records, 72 GPTBot visits, a new article crawled within 24 hours, and 264 junk requests filtered out — turned into a copyable step-by-step playbook for any site owner.

item.title: The GEO Content Template — How We Structure Every Article So AI Cites Us
item.description: A GEO content template built from real pages on GEO Encyclopedia: scenario opening, question H2s, answer-first blocks, comparison tables, FAQPage JSON-LD, and the pre-publish checklist.

item.title: What is JSON-LD? — Structured Data Explained for GEO
item.description: A practical GEO guide to JSON-LD structured data: what it is, why it matters for AI visibility, JSON-LD vs Microdata, and how the GEO Encyclopedia homepage uses WebSite, Organization, and ItemList schemas.

item.title: GEO Encyclopedia Community — Share Knowledge, Ask Questions
item.description: Join the GEO Encyclopedia community: explore community articles, join the discussion, and contact the editorial team.
